name: Mobile Action Bar
description: A bar at the bottom of the screen on phones with Call, Email, Directions and your own button, like Book a table. One tap for visitors, no JavaScript.

panels.title: Mobile action bar
panels.description: Buttons fixed to the bottom of the screen for visitors on a phone. Only the buttons you fill in are shown. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Show the action bar
fields.description: Turn this off to hide it without losing your details.

fields.name: phone
fields.title: Phone number
fields.description: Shows a Call button, for example +31 20 123 4567.

fields.name: address
fields.title: Address
fields.description: Shows a Directions button that opens the address in Google Maps, for example NDSM-plein 28, Amsterdam.

fields.name: button-text
fields.title: Your own button
fields.description: The main button, for example Book a table or Order now.

fields.name: button-url
fields.title: Link of your own button
fields.description: A page on your site such as /book, or a full address.

fields.name: language
fields.title: Language of the buttons
fields.description: For the words Call, Email and Directions.

fields.name: colour
fields.title: Colour
fields.description: Used for the icons and your own button. Its text colour is chosen for you.

fields.name: skip-pages
fields.title: Skip these pages
fields.description: Page addresses separated by commas, for example: checkout, blog/*. A * at the end means every page under it.
